phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
She confronted the man to demand closure about their relationship.
She organized a spontaneous trip to forget her troubles.
She contacted three friends to create a support network.
She returned the red box with an apology letter.
She reconnected with family members for reconciliation.
She planned a public event to embarrass the man.
